mechanism: Piperacillin-tazobactam may reduce renal clearance of dapagliflozin through competitive tubular secretion, potentially increasing dapagliflozin exposure and SGLT2 inhibitor-related adverse effects.
action: Monitor for increased SGLT2 inhibitor side effects (genital infections, polyuria, euglycemic DKA) during concurrent use; renal function should be assessed given dapagliflozin's renal dependence.
